key_insight: HemOncAgent is a hybrid AI retrieval system that chooses between structured and narrative oncology knowledge sources to answer treatment questions more reliably than single-source approaches.
clinical_relevance: It could help clinicians and researchers quickly find more complete, context-aware oncology drug and regimen information across both databases and free-text care pathways.
method: Selects the best retrieval tool for each question
Searches HemOncKB for structured pharmacologic relationships
Searches HemOnc.org for narrative treatment-sequencing guidance
evidence_signal: The abstract reports high-fidelity retrieval across structured and narrative benchmarks, especially where single-source systems had domain-specific limitations.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality, coverage, and maintenance of the underlying knowledge sources, so gaps or inconsistencies could still affect outputs.
paper_title: HemOncAgent: an artificial intelligence system for retrieving structured and narrative oncology knowledge
